Co; 𝔗 ומדי, whence MezStadt Ḥarrân 34 כָּל־מָדַי all Media; JKi Hi Co כְּלִמּוּד (רְכֻלָּתֵךְ) Asshur was as thine apprentice (v. sub למד in trading; but sense not very prob.
